en.p: For the function $f(x)=x^{2}-4x-3$, let $l$ be the tangent line to the curve $y=f(x)$ at the point $(1,\,-6)$. For the function $g(x)=\left(x^{3}-2x\right)f(x)$, let $m$ be the tangent line to the curve $y=g(x)$ at the point $(1,\,6)$. What is the area of the region enclosed by the two lines $l$, $m$ and the $y$-axis? [4 points]
